    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B12
    • 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요

Health Functional FoodMagnesium 440mgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B6 1.5mgOnce a day

더쎈 마그네슘 440Magnesium · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 440mg of Magnesium, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 440mg Magnesium, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Magnesium labelled (440mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 흰색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Magnesium · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
